title: Simon 3.5, injective regular case: weighted area formula for an arbitrary nonnegative weight
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and ℝᵈ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d). Let s ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ a map such that Φ is differentiable at every x ∈ s, DΦ(x) is injective for every x ∈ s, and Φ is injective on s. Let g : ℝᴺ → [0, ∞] be an arbitrary function; no measurability is assumed. Then ∫⁻_{y∈Φ(s)} g(y) dμHE[n](y) = ∫⁻_{x∈s} ofReal(areaJacobian(DΦ(x)))·g(Φ(x)) dμHE[n](x), where areaJacobian(L) = √det(L* ∘ L).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (s : Set (Rn n)) (Φ : Rn n → Rn N) (g : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet s → (∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x) → (∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → InjOn Φ s → ∫⁻ y in Φ '' s, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (areaJacobian (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) * g (Φ x) ∂μHE[n]
